title: Cost cap introduced
description: First FIA Financial Regulations for F1 teams. Cap reduced from a planned 175M to 145M during COVID-19 (WMSC decision, 2020). Based on 21 races; engine, driver salaries and top-3 staff pay are excluded.

title: Cost cap stepped down
description: Base cap lowered to 140M. Later raised by 3.1% for inflation during the season.

title: Cost cap base 135M for 2023-2025
description: Base level 135M for a 21-race season, with adjustments for extra races and inflation.

title: Cost cap rises to 215M under wider definition
description: Nominal cap rises to 215M because previously excluded costs are brought inside the cap. Not comparable with the 2021-2025 figures without adjustment.

title: 1.6L V6 turbo hybrid power units
description: Start of the hybrid power-unit era.
